title: Epochal rollout runbook with temporal approvals and forensic evidence bundle
creator: Asha Menon
description: Design and ship an operational runbook and lightweight approval flow for 'epochal' model rollouts: canaries/A-B/shadow slices that progress in time-epochs (eg 15m, 1h, 6h) with automated scoring, mandatory human gate at configurable epochs, and an immutable forensic bundle collected at each gate. The flow must integrate RBAC (role-aware approver groups), timeboxed approvals (expiration and auto-escalation), and cryptographic evidence recording (signed pseudo-bundles stored in customer audit logs). Emphasis on low friction for PLG users and strict controls for enterprise customers. Deliverables: runbook doc, approval API contract, RBAC matrix, evidence bundle schema, and Console UI wireframes for temporal approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook describes epoch definitions, gating criteria, and rollback triggers for canary/A-B/shadow patterns
Approval API supports create/approve/reject with expiry and reason field and returns an evidence bundle id
RBAC matrix implemented: roles mapped to approver groups with delegation rules and expiry windows
Evidence bundle contains immutable snapshot: rollout config, traffic split, metrics snapshot, sample requests/responses (scrubbed), approver signature, and link to retention location
Console shows pending approvals with time-to-expiry, ability to attach mitigation notes, and one-click emergency rollback
implementation_notes: Prototype approval API in GH branch: github.com/redwood-inference/rollouts/pull/482
Backend work: add evidence-bundle encoder to ingestion pipeline (ENG-30255), and tie to audit-log retention policy
Security: coordinate with Security (KMS signing for bundle fingerprints) - see security ticket SEC-1142
Telemetry: add canary scoring metric 'epoch_pass_rate' and alert if < 95% over 3 consecutive epochs
